title: The substrate matters only through the algorithms it can implement

statements.text: Whether a system is conscious depends on features more abstract than the lowest-level details of its physical makeup. The material substrate matters for consciousness only insofar as it affects which algorithms the system can implement, so consciousness is in principle multiply realizable, not confined to biological brains.

sources.quote: The material substrate of a system does not matter for consciousness except insofar as the substrate affects which algorithms the system can implement.
it can exist in multiple substrates, not just in biological brains
